heads.en: FT: Huang In-hoon's cheating daughter Huang Lok and Kang Wai are "power partners" and she has changed her last name to a different name to dilute the Chinese and NVIDIA's Executive Director Huang In-hoon's involvement in the affair and Chinese espionage. A recent investigation by the Financial Times revealed that Huang Lok was born in a rural village in Hunan, China, and that he was a Chinese official media journalist in his early years, and then turned to the financial circle, where he maintained a relationship of love and business cooperation for almost 10 years with a financier who was repeatedly punished by Chinese voucher regulators. They were considered by the Chinese financial community as "power partners" and some even thought they were married. 1 hour ago, the international FT: Huang Hong-hoon's affair was a "power partner."
